story_type_guidance.daily_news: Use straightforward documentary style. Open with 'In the world of battle rap...' or direct introduction of key players.
story_type_guidance.career_retrospective: Use biographical style. Open with '[Name], born [Real Name], was a...' and trace their journey.
story_type_guidance.crime_legal_story: For stories about arrests, snitching, court cases, you MAY use more atmospheric/noir style if appropriate. But default to straightforward unless it's truly a crime investigation piece.
